items.summary: 在一次汽车后备箱拍卖中发现的一枚 1834 年英国银币变形异常，可能保存了近 200 年前罕见的铸币事故的证据。先进的 3D 扫描和显微分析显示出不寻常的金属变形，表明硬币在极端压力下被压碎，可能是在其使用过程中。
items.summary_orig: A bizarrely deformed 1834 British silver coin found at a car boot sale may preserve evidence of a rare minting accident nearly 200 years ago. items.summary: 当像太阳这样的低质量恒星老化时，它们会离开主序并跟随红巨星分支。当它们上升到这个分支时，它们的亮度稳步增加。但路径中存在一种称为 RGB 亮度凹凸的小问题，它们的亮度会突然下降。
items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.
